package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `hlsl`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`float4 main() : SV_Target { return 0; }`, config)
	if err != nil {

	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
